# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On October 23, 2023, Cardinal Health, Inc. (an Ohio corporation) executed a consent letter with multiple financial institutions to amend its Performance Guaranty covenants.
- The transaction involves Cardinal Health, Inc. as Performance Guarantor for Cardinal Health 23 Funding, LLC and Cardinal Health Funding, LLC (both Nevada limited liability companies).
- The financial institution consortium includes MUFG Bank, Ltd. (as Agent), PNC Bank, N.A. (as LC Bank), The Bank of Nova Scotia, Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. (as Managing Agent), and Bank of America, N.A., along with conduit entities Victory Receivables Corporation and Liberty Street Funding LLC.
- The purpose is to update Section 7 of the Performance Guaranties to reference the amended Credit Agreement covenant (Section 6.12) that was previously modified on February 27, 2023.
- Cardinal Health operates as a healthcare services and products company, maintaining structured financing arrangements through special purpose vehicles with asset-backed securities programs supported by performance guarantees.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• Strong banking consortium including major financial institutions (MUFG, PNC, Bank of Nova Scotia, Wells Fargo, Bank of America) indicating broad lender support
• Established receivables financing structure with multiple conduit facilities providing diversified funding sources
• Formal consent process demonstrates adherence to covenant compliance and transparency with lenders
• Performance guaranty structure provides additional credit support for the financing vehicles

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• The amendment allows for higher leverage ratios (4.25x vs. 3.75x) during "Leverage Holiday" periods following Material Acquisitions, potentially increasing credit risk
• Complex multi-entity structure with various SPVs and conduits may create operational complexity
• Limited financial information available in this consent document constrains comprehensive credit assessment
